title: One of Many Charges - Electromagnetic Field Visualization
full_prompt: Write a Manim scene class named `OneOfManyCharges` that visualizes the electromagnetic field (specifically the radiation/Lorentz force component) generated by a moving charged particle. The scene should define a `ChargedParticle` class that tracks its position and acceleration history. It should compute the Lorentz force field using retarded times (accounting for the speed of light delay) and visualize this field using a vector field or field lines that update dynamically as the particle moves. The particle should undergo some oscillatory or accelerated motion, and the resulting radiation field (the transverse component of the electric field proportional to acceleration) should be clearly visualized propagating outwards.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect history tracking or index out of bounds in particle position/acceleration history arrays
common_failure_modes.note: The history tracking relies on circular buffers or large pre-allocated numpy arrays. Incorrect indexing will crash the simulation.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Division by zero or extremely large values near the particle center
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the adjusted norms function correctly handles points close to the particle center to prevent numerical blow-ups.
